verdict.rationale: Lighthouse is a managed immigration legal-services firm. Its core product is attorney review, case managers and petition preparation, delivered as a service, so self-hosting the core product is a category error for this kind of offering. The supporting case-prep platform is part of that managed service, and nothing in the evidence indicates a deployable or self-hostable software distribution that would make the axis apply.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
